prs.body:
This adds a case to the FlowCross debug logging that identifies differences in behavior between Taker and FlowCross.  The logging is only enabled if the `CompareTakerFlowCross` feature is enabled in the config file.  So you needn't be concerned about a flood of new warning-level log messages.

When it is generated, a typical message looks like:
```
FlowCross: Both Taker and Flow fully crossed different; Taker XRP rounded to zero.  tx: ...
```
Reviewers: @ximinez, @mellery451.  Thanks.

issues.title: `FlowCross` is overdue for retirement
issues.author: Bronek
issues.body:
## Issue Description


Amendment `FlowCross` has been voted and enabled in 2020. In 2025 we have released `PermissionedDEX` which relies on `FlowCross` (e.g. in `CreateOffer::preflight`)

That is, if `rippled` was running on a network where `FlowCross` is not enabled, then `PermissionedDEX` even if enabled, won't work as designed.

It is time to move `FlowCross` to `XRPL_RETIRE`.
